text:
Fanning, like fire, a loving heart

under chaste black cloak, happy, gloved hand,

one day as he went, atrocious, meek, yellow,

drooling his faith through his toothless mouth,


one day as he went, "Oremus," a Devil

grabbed him roughly by his pious ear,

letting loose frightful words at him, and tearing

the chaste black cloak from his warm sweaty skin.


Punishment!... His clothes are unbuttoned,

and his long rosary of remiss sins

parade over his chest; Saint Tartuffe is pale!...


He was confessing, at last, praying amid death rattles!

And the man could only carry off his ruffles...

—Tartuffe is completely naked, ugh, how disgusting!

translation.title: The Punishment of Tartuffe
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the anticlerical undressing farce and Tartuffe's exposed hypocrisy.
